text: Chandler Martin Page, a salesperson in the RegionalSales team, has been flagged for an anomaly due to his browsing behavior. Specifically, he visited job-search sites seven times this week, which is significantly higher than his typical activity (0 visits) and above the maximum recorded (21). This deviates from what we've observed among same-role peers, who only had one instance of such activity in total (z=4.05).
